# Econ Writing Skill (econ-write)

license: `MIT` · 1 skills · last update: 2026-07-20

**Source:** <https://github.com/hanlulong/econ-writing-skill>

**Maintainers:** Lu Han

**Compatibility:** `claude-code` `codex`

> A single, widely-adopted (632 stars) SKILL.md that synthesizes writing guidance from 50+ authoritative sources on economics writing — Cochrane, McCloskey, Shapiro, Head, Bellemare, Goldin, Katz, Glaeser, Kremer and others — into concrete formulas and style rules for every section of a paper (abstract, introduction, identification narrative, tables, conclusion) plus referee responses, grant proposals, and LaTeX formatting. Four companion reference files ship alongside SKILL.md (identification- strategies.md: 13 identification strategies; latex-tips.md; review-checklist.md; specialized-tasks.md) but are reference material invoked from within the one skill, not separately installable skills, so only econ-write is catalogued here. Sibling tools by the same author: econ-paper-review-skill (catalogued as a project, referee-report generation) and econ-slides-skill (Beamer conversion, not yet catalogued).


**Source YAML:** [`skills/econ-writing-skill.yml`](https://github.com/bhanneke/RISE/blob/main/skills/econ-writing-skill.yml)
